text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like it's about to begin. 
Believe and Durandal... huh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Their running shows they share the same 
roots, and they're on the same path! And 
yet—their styles are completely different!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And both of them... have honed themselves 
to what must be near their absolute 
limits. Now, I wonder what kind of race 
we'll see today—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Durandal? Why are you 
trembling so?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for the restrooms, go 
way back down and turn right.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That is so not it, jeez!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I was sharpening my focus! Even if it's 
just a prep race, this one run will 
undoubtedly foretell what's to come in the 
Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I kept telling myself to 
sharpen my blade... and focus strictly on 
my own running, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh... To exude such an overwhelming aura 
of supremacy...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san. Right O-san. ...Thank you 
for your time today.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just what on earth... did you do over the 
summer?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That presence... That conditioning! Just 
what did she do to reach this level...?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—I... was simply honing myself as always. 
Both body and mind, for this very day.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm here today... to show you work that 
surpasses your own.
